observations: Photo 0 shows a complete car engine bay/engine assembly on the ground with hoses, wiring, intake/exhaust components, and a silver engine block; no clear engine code visible.
Photo 1 shows the engine from another angle with the intake/airbox area and more wiring/hoses; again no readable engine code/label.
Photo 2 shows the engine with a large plastic cover/airbox and surrounding components; no readable model/engine code visible.

claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators for toyota venza, camry, sienna, Hylander,...
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly with hoses/wiring and some attached components, but there is no clear, readable proof of (1) the exact Toyota engine model/code, (2) that an A/C compressor is included, or (3) that 'all the operators' (full set of required parts) are present.

risks.risk: Exact engine identification is not readable (could be a different Toyota engine family or wrong fitment).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamping on the block/head (and/or the VIN/engine code label if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used Toyota-compatible engine assembly with unknown exact engine code (worst-case fitment risk).

risks.risk: A/C compressor may be missing or not included (seller claims 'with compressor').
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the A/C compressor body with its pulley and mounting bracket, or a photo of all included A/C parts laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine assembly without confirmed compressor (worst-case: compressor not included).

risks.risk: Not confirmed complete: 'all the operators' could mean missing sensors, brackets, wiring harness sections, alternator/PS pump, or other required parts.
risks.proof: A checklist photo: lay out and show every included component (alternator, starter, sensors, harness connectors, brackets, hoses, etc.) with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed complete (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown (no running video, no compression test, no leak check).
risks.proof: Short video of the engine running (or at least cranking) plus a compression test/diagnostic printout.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: may need repairs).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID stamping or label on the block/head (readable).
Photo confirming the A/C compressor is physically included (pulley + mounting visible).
Photo checklist of all included parts (lay out everything the buyer will receive).
Video of the engine cranking/running (or diagnostic/compression test results).
response.reason: The photos show an engine assembly, but the exact engine code and whether the A/C compressor and full required parts are included cannot be confirmed from the images. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be reliably matched to the correct engine type.
